surface_mechanism_description: The self-limiting ALD growth mode was confirmed at 325 °C for both precursors. The titanium (N,N′-diisopropylacetamidinate)tri(isopropoxide)/water process showed an ALD window at 300 −350 °C, and titanium bis(dimethylamide)bis(isopropoxide) exhibited an interestingly high growth rate of 0.75 Å/cycle at 325 °C. The films were crystallized to the anatase phase in the as-deposited state.
